# Miguel Cordero Collar

> Personal website and CV of Miguel Cordero Collar, IT Innovation Project Manager at Red Bull.

This site publishes professional profile information and personal collections. Follow the linked source material for attribution and context. Collection Markdown files include complete snapshots; JSON files are the underlying structured data.

## Profile

- [Homepage profile](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/index.md): Full professional profile followed by links to machine-readable collections.
- [CV](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/documents/Miguel-Cordero-CV.md): Curated AI-focused CV with experience, projects, skills, education and contact information. Matches the two-page PDF.
- [Homepage](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/): Canonical HTML profile.

## Collections

- [People](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/people/index.md): Personal reflections on public figures; includes biography and source links. [JSON data](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/people/people-data.json).
- [Quotes](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/quotes/index.md): Collected wording with author, source attribution and original wording when available. [JSON data](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/quotes/quotes-data.json).
- [Trends](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/trends/index.md): Personal interest context and Google Trends snapshots, with query links and data. [JSON data](https://miguelcorderocollar.com/trends/trends-data.json).
